content: Axon docs pitfall evidence: EventCriteria havingTags alone without andBeingOneOfTypes loads more than needed and clashes with unrelated changes; tagKey derived from a field name silently changes if the field is renamed; typed identifier tag values use toString() so it must be overridden; docs warn against re-tagging existing events; event processors over a DCB store default to SequentialPolicy because framework cannot infer ordering. Command sequencing (RoutingKeySequencingPolicy) serializes same-routing-key commands before they reach the repository, which can mask a race that was meant to exercise the append condition.
